fusions.name: Driven Stake
fusions.desc: A stake driven home deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bruised] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Taproot Slam
fusions.desc: Drives the head into the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and restoring 5 health to you. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Slow Sap
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Fed by the Fallen
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
